user.title: Qrio account
user.description: Sign in with your Qrio account. Your password is used once to mint a local key, then discarded — lock/unlock runs entirely over Bluetooth with no cloud. You'll pick which lock to add next.

select_lock.title: Choose a lock
select_lock.description: Select the lock to add. Run the integration again to add another.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-mint Qrio key
reauth_confirm.description: Re-enter the password for {email} to mint a fresh key.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Qrio service.
error.lock_gone: That lock is no longer on this account.

abort.already_configured: This lock is already set up.
abort.all_configured: Every lock on this account is already set up.

init.title: Transport (local / cloud)
init.description: Choose how status reads and lock/unlock reach this lock. Cloud uses your Qrio Hub — it's faster and works even if the Bluetooth proxy is down, but it requires storing a Qrio refresh token in Home Assistant to keep the cloud session alive. Status defaults to local to keep cloud traffic low.

cloud_auth.title: Re-enable cloud
cloud_auth.description: Enter the password for {email} to re-mint the cloud session token (it was cleared when you switched to local only). Your existing local key is kept.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Qrio service.
error.no_hub: This lock no longer has a paired Qrio Hub.

abort.no_hub: This lock has no paired Qrio Hub, so cloud control isn't available — it runs over local Bluetooth only.
